appended.mechanism_name: Apply a stable covalent heparin coating to the inner lumen (and possibly outer surface) of tunneled hemodialysis cathete
appended.what_was_proposed: Heparin coating on the catheter surface provides localized anticoagulant activity that inhibits thrombus formation and maintains lumen patency.
